The 1967–68 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 34th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[association football|football]] in Portugal.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship.
